profile.headline: Software Engineer at The Walt Disney Company
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the investment management industry. Skilled in Front and Back end web development technologies such as Angular, Angular 2, React, Backbone, Javascript, JQuery, HTML5, CSS3, MySQL, AWS, .NET, Java.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Summary:  Full Stack Web development on an end to end property lifecycle management  MVC web application.  

Technology stack: Linux, AWS, MySQL, Java (Gradle,Hibernate,Spring Framework), Backbone JS, Angular JS, Bootstrap, CSS3, Jenkins, Tomcat

Specifics: 

• Daily  front-end implementations of property administration pages using  Backbone JS including REST service integration.

• Daily REST service creation via Java Spring Framework Web. 

• Daily database persistence integration via Java Spring Framework.

• Biweekly stand-up meetings. Agile development with 2 week sprints.

• Weekly MySQL database design and modification.

• Migration of Backbone to Angular on internal property management application.

• Migration of Angular to Angular 2 on Ionic mobile application.

• Developed Hybrid IOS/Android projects to support internal property management using Ionic, Angular, Ionic2, Angular2, Typescript, Cordova.

• Developed Cron triggered Automation and external integration tools to auto import data from external sources into our internal application.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
• Multi-Platform Mobile App development (Cordova/Phonegap, IntelXDK, Javascript, JQuery, CSS, HTML5, Backbone.js )

• Front End Web Development (Javascript, JQuery, CSS, HTML5, Backbone.js)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Summary: Write and test features for an MVVM based automation management windows application using C#,XAML, .NET framework.

• Daily C# and .NET programming on WPF application

• Daily scrum stand-up meetings. Agile development with 2 week Sprints

• QA Testing using C# tests on WPF application.

positions.title: Test System Operator
positions.description:
Summary: 7Layers is a wireless signal testing facility that tests and screens any new incoming tech devices that use any wireless forms of communication(eg. 2G, 3G, 4G, Bluetooth) 

• Troubleshoot, control, and supervise test systems

• Perform tests on mobile devices

• Communicate and teach testing practices to customers.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Summary: As an undergraduate student, I was wanting to learn and get a big head start on studies in Computer Science, so I reached out to Professor Alex  Nicolau, who connected me with Dr. Ro Cammarota to mentor and teach me. Our projects all focused around optimization and efficiency of CPU's and software. 

• Assist in the development of Benchmarks for WebRTC

• Assist in research projects involving performance tuning for web applications and compilers such as GCC

• Assist in data sampling for data analysis

positions.title: SURF-IT Undergraduate Research Fellow
positions.description:
Summary: UC Irvine has many Summer programs under its Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship in Information Technology(SURF-IT). In the programs, Students, guided by research professors at the university, perform and demonstrate their own research throughout the summer. 

• Generate and collect data to test computer efficiency with compiler optimizations

• Test, create and develop methods of analysis for data to predict CPU performance

• Present multiple research presentations to peers and faculty including a final symposium presentation

positions.title: Intern (LAUSD Construction Group)
positions.description:
Summary: The  LAUSD Construction Group manages all LAUSD school building designs and contracts concerning construction. 

• Construction change order data entry and verification

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Participated in various cleanups including the beach, park, and local neighborhoods.

• Provided school tours as an Alumni.
